title: Macro %grp_score (reusable group-score calculation)
notes: Translate once as a function; the five group steps call it. Five parts: (1) flag/count/average data step, (2) PROC STANDARD mean=0 std=1, (3) PROC MEANS mean and std, (4) SQL cross join adds Mean and StdDev to every row, (5) merge by provider_ID, avg->score_before_std, standardized avg->grp_score. sum(of ...) ignores missing values. Both std calls use n-1 (ddof=1). Read PROVIDER_ID as text (leading zeros). Output columns in order: PROVIDER_ID, measures, C1..Cn, total_cnt, measure_wt, score_before_std, Mean, StdDev, grp_score. If total_cnt is 0, measure_wt and avg stay missing (not expected: program 0 keeps hospitals with Total_m_cnt >= 1).
